data.name: Nureen
data.gender_notes: Nureen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'nur' meaning 'light'. In Islamic tradition, this name represents the light and guidance that comes from Allah. The name Nureen carries the meaning “Light, Luminous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nureen usually hope their child will grow to embody light, luminous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of enlightenment and guidance in the Islamic faith.
data.etymology: Nureen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Luminous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nureen total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
